caseNameFull: LYNAUGH, INTERIM DIRECTOR, TEXAS DEPARTMENT OF CORRECTIONS v. PETTY

Keller, Executive Assistant Attorney General, and F. Scott McCown and William C. Zapalac, Assistant Attorneys General., John R. Breihan by appointment of the Court, 479 U. opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The writ of certiorari is dismissed as improvidently granted.
